item.title: Verbose beta 256
item.description:
Privacy and security fixes

Mac

  • Links in transcripts open only web pages. A link that names a file or another app no longer opens it.
  • Only Verbose's own widgets can start a recording or dictation through a link. Another app or a web page that opens a Verbose link brings Verbose forward without turning on the microphone.

Also on iPhone

  • Verbose is free on iPhone, with a 7-day free trial that starts when you tap it.
  • A free recording saves at 10 minutes and transcribes, instead of stopping cold.
  • Settings shows your free trial's days left, and has Restore Purchases.
  • Send to Reminders works from Plan my day.
  • Cloud cleanup asks before it sends your words to Anthropic or OpenAI.
  • Delete all data also removes your voice profile, named voices, plans, and templates.
  • A link from another app opens today's Thoughts page instead of starting a thought.
  • Privacy policy and Terms of use in Settings open the right pages.
  • The microphone step in the welcome tour leads straight to the system's question.
